name: IT limits
description: Prints the limits the container's cgroup carries (memory, processes, CPUs) and what the container may do as a process.

config.command: echo uid=$(id -u) gid=$(id -g) caps=$(grep CapEff /proc/self/status | cut -f2) nnp=$(grep NoNewPrivs /proc/self/status | cut -f2); touch /root-probe 2>/dev/null && echo root-writable || echo root-read-only; touch /tmp/probe && echo tmp-writable
